description: The same four probe binaries under the pre-existing Verilator simulator. Three samples each; all three are byte-identical in their measurement values, so the platform is verified deterministic and further repeats would add no information.

source_revision.note: the probes predate this repo's B0 work; their own identities are below

cpu_config.name: teaching CPU, PHYSICAL_PORT_V2, M/C/A/Sv39
cpu_config.note: same RTL as the board build; the SoC harness differs

simulator_provenance.inputs_manifest: inputs.sha256 beside the binary, listing 16 source files
simulator_provenance.note: this is the ACCEPTED pre-existing simulator, reused. No claim is made that it was rebuilt for B0.

frequency.derivation: the simulator has no clock; 40 MHz is applied so that derived IPS is comparable in FORM with the board. It is NOT a simulated frequency and the simulator's cycle counts do not correspond to board time.
frequency.caution: simulator CPI is not board CPI: this simulator models no PS or DDR path at all

memory_layout.note: harness memory model; not the board's PS DDR via the HP port

sample_policy.rationale: the simulator is deterministic and this run verifies it: repeats beyond confirming identity would only inflate a count

timing_method: core mcycle/minstret (or cycle/instret in S-mode) read either side of the ROI; see benchmarks/metrics.md section 2
output_checks: each probe asserts its own retired count and prints a completion marker; the parser re-checks both and refuses the record otherwise
